sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 27B GGUF | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 27B GGUF is a 27B parameter reasoning language model compressed to true 2 bit ternary weights (1.71 bits per weight), derived from a Qwen3.6-27B hybrid attention backbone. It runs in a roughly 7.2GB footprint on laptops, single GPUs, and CPUs via llama.cpp, while retaining strong math, coding, tool use, and long context (262K token) reasoning performance.

sources.snippet: Overview Ternary-Bonsai-27B-gguf is a 27.3-billion-parameter language model with end-to-end ternary (1.71-bit) weights built by prism-ml for llama.cpp on CUDA, Metal, and CPU backends. The model achieves a 9.4x reduction in size compared to FP16 (7.2 GB deployed versus 54 GB) while retaining 95% of full-precision reasoning capability across 15 thinking-mode benchmarks. sources.snippet: Provides a 27B-class Qwen3.6-derived language model in GGUF with end-to-end ternary weights (Q2_0_g128), reducing deployed footprint to ~7.2 GB while retaining ~95% of FP16 reasoning ability and enabling on-device 262K-token context inference.
